jobs.title: Market Conduct Surveillance Analyst
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Type
Full Time
Job Reference #
336879BR
City
Shanghai
Key Responsibilities
Do you like financial markets? Are you good at handling and interpreting large data sets? Are you analytical and enjoy investigating financial transactions, understanding trading strategies and making sense of the unusual trading activity?
We are seeking an experienced Market Conduct Surveillance Analyst with deep practitioner experience, capable of operating with a high degree of independence while remaining fully embedded within an integrated regional surveillance framework. In this role, you will:
Perform end‑to‑end trade surveillance activities across the Investment Bank (IB) and Global Wealth Management (GWM) businesses, with primary accountability for China‑local activity.
Independently analyze alerts, exceptions and instances of potentially unusual or suspicious trading activity generated by surveillance systems, forming well‑reasoned conclusions.
Apply deep, practical knowledge of China local securities regulations, including Abnormal Trading Rules and Program Trading Rules, when assessing and determining market conduct risk.
Leverage a strong understanding of cash equities and related IB & GWM products, execution processes, trading strategies and the end‑to‑end trade lifecycle to support robust and defensible investigations.
Act as the primary surveillance authority for China‑local activity, exercising a high degree of independent analysis, judgment and decision‑making in risk assessments and outcomes.
Engage directly with front‑office businesses, control functions and regional partners on escalations, inquiries and remediation actions, challenging where appropriate.
Represent surveillance function in interactions with exchange surveillance teams and regulators, including responding to inquiries and managing follow‑ups as required.
Collaborate closely with colleagues as part of an integrated APAC Market Conduct Surveillance team, actively participating in regional training and knowledge sharing initiatives to promote cross market consistency while addressing China specific market conduct risks.
Drive continuous process improvements and contribute to strategic initiatives, automation and optimization projects within the function.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with senior management and key stakeholders across the first and second lines of defence in China and across the region, establishing credibility as a trusted subject‑matter expert.
The team
You will be part of the APAC Market Conduct Surveillance team functionally, a second‑line function within Group Compliance and Operational Risk Control, supporting the firm in achieving its strategic, operational and regulatory objectives.
The role is based in Shanghai, with primary accountability for China‑local trade surveillance activities. In addition to day‑to‑day surveillance coverage, the role will play a key part in establishing and further developing the Market Conduct Surveillance operating model in China, aligned with existing APAC governance, standards and escalation frameworks.
While operating with a high degree of independence in line with local regulatory and data‑privacy requirements, the role is fully integrated within the broader APAC regional framework, providing exposure to regional governance, escalation practices and cross‑market regulatory expectations, alongside focused ownership of China‑specific market conduct risks.
Your Skills And Experience
Proven hands‑on experience in market conduct and/or trade surveillance within a financial institution or securities regulator.
Strong hands‑on experience with automated trade surveillance systems, including scenario design and system configuration, with the ability to independently review, assess and dispose of alerts and to propose enhancements to surveillance coverage where appropriate.
Strong knowledge of China securities market regulations, with particular emphasis on Abnormal Trading Rules and Program Trading Rules, and proven ability to apply these rules in both the design and tuning of surveillance scenarios and the independent assessment and disposition of alerts.
Demonstrated experience independently handling exchange‑driven surveillance inquiries and regulatory referrals from SSE/SZSE, including analysis, response formulation and follow‑up.
Solid understanding of execution processes for cash equities and related instruments, including order handling, execution workflows and post‑trade processes.
Strong understanding of trading strategies, market behavior and the end‑to‑end trade lifecycle, enabling meaningful and well‑reasoned analysis of suspicious or unusual trading activity.
Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to investigate issues in depth, identify root causes and reach sound, defensible conclusions.
Excellent organizational, time‑management, documentation and problem‑solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail.
Commitment to staying current on regulatory developments, internal policy changes and evolving market practices.
Ability to communicate clearly, confidently and credibly with a broad range of stakeholders, including senior business and compliance stakeholders and regional partners.

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

Job Type

City

Shanghai

Key Responsibilities

Do you like financial markets? Are you good at handling and interpreting large data sets? Are you analytical and enjoy investigating financial transactions, understanding trading strategies and making sense of the unusual trading activity?

We are seeking an experienced Market Conduct Surveillance Analyst with deep practitioner experience, capable of operating with a high degree of independence while remaining fully embedded within an integrated regional surveillance framework. In this role, you will:

  • Perform end‑to‑end trade surveillance activities across the Investment Bank (IB) and Global Wealth Management (GWM) businesses, with primary accountability for China‑local activity.
  • Independently analyze alerts, exceptions and instances of potentially unusual or suspicious trading activity generated by surveillance systems, forming well‑reasoned conclusions.
  • Apply deep, practical knowledge of China local securities regulations, including Abnormal Trading Rules and Program Trading Rules, when assessing and determining market conduct risk.
  • Leverage a strong understanding of cash equities and related IB & GWM products, execution processes, trading strategies and the end‑to‑end trade lifecycle to support robust and defensible investigations.
  • Act as the primary surveillance authority for China‑local activity, exercising a high degree of independent analysis, judgment and decision‑making in risk assessments and outcomes.
  • Engage directly with front‑office businesses, control functions and regional partners on escalations, inquiries and remediation actions, challenging where appropriate.
  • Represent surveillance function in interactions with exchange surveillance teams and regulators, including responding to inquiries and managing follow‑ups as required.
  • Collaborate closely with colleagues as part of an integrated APAC Market Conduct Surveillance team, actively participating in regional training and knowledge sharing initiatives to promote cross market consistency while addressing China specific market conduct risks.
  • Drive continuous process improvements and contribute to strategic initiatives, automation and optimization projects within the function.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with senior management and key stakeholders across the first and second lines of defence in China and across the region, establishing credibility as a trusted subject‑matter expert.

The team

You will be part of the APAC Market Conduct Surveillance team functionally, a second‑line function within Group Compliance and Operational Risk Control, supporting the firm in achieving its strategic, operational and regulatory objectives.

The role is based in Shanghai, with primary accountability for China‑local trade surveillance activities. In addition to day‑to‑day surveillance coverage, the role will play a key part in establishing and further developing the Market Conduct Surveillance operating model in China, aligned with existing APAC governance, standards and escalation frameworks.

While operating with a high degree of independence in line with local regulatory and data‑privacy requirements, the role is fully integrated within the broader APAC regional framework, providing exposure to regional governance, escalation practices and cross‑market regulatory expectations, alongside focused ownership of China‑specific market conduct risks.

Your Skills And Experience

  • Proven hands‑on experience in market conduct and/or trade surveillance within a financial institution or securities regulator.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with automated trade surveillance systems, including scenario design and system configuration, with the ability to independently review, assess and dispose of alerts and to propose enhancements to surveillance coverage where appropriate.
  • Strong knowledge of China securities market regulations, with particular emphasis on Abnormal Trading Rules and Program Trading Rules, and proven ability to apply these rules in both the design and tuning of surveillance scenarios and the independent assessment and disposition of alerts.
  • Demonstrated experience independently handling exchange‑driven surveillance inquiries and regulatory referrals from SSE/SZSE, including analysis, response formulation and follow‑up.
  • Solid understanding of execution processes for cash equities and related instruments, including order handling, execution workflows and post‑trade processes.
  • Strong understanding of trading strategies, market behavior and the end‑to‑end trade lifecycle, enabling meaningful and well‑reasoned analysis of suspicious or unusual trading activity.
  • Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to investigate issues in depth, identify root causes and reach sound, defensible conclusions.
  • Excellent organizational, time‑management, documentation and problem‑solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Commitment to staying current on regulatory developments, internal policy changes and evolving market practices.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, confidently and credibly with a broad range of stakeholders, including senior business and compliance stakeholders and regional partners.

jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Talent Program - Group Technology Office - Shanghai
jobs.descriptionText:
Your role
Interested in working in finance, and have a passion for technology, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?
We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Group Technology Office Graduate Talent Program.
You’ll Get To
develop and implement technical solutions
enable multi-tenant services like cluster management; security; resource and quota management; partitioning; monitoring chargeback; data governance; quality; and lineage
provide transparency across data quality, data flows and current issues to ensure applications are of the highest standards
Your team
You’ll be working in the Group Technology Office located in Shanghai. We’re responsible for sourcing, developing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting our world-class technology solutions. We’re a global organization with multiple streams that align with each of the key functional areas within UBS to ensure that our solutions meet business needs. Based on your interests and experience, you could be placed as a Software Engineering Graduate, or AI Engineering Graduate.
Your expertise
We’re Looking For a Candidate Who
will graduate by June 2027, with less than two years of work experience
has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team.
Your program
Our Graduate Talent Program is 24 months long, and designed to help you develop the skills you need to grow your career. To start, the program introduces you to our firm, provides professional and technical training and teaches you core skills and knowledge of the Group Technology Office. And it continues from there: by learning from your colleagues, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and build your network. Job Type
Full Time
Job Reference #
343574BR
City
Shanghai
Key Responsibilities
We are looking for someone who can
Participate in the pricing and risk analysis of various portfolios. The analysis reports are basis for making trading or hedging decisions on the portfolio.
Develop light spreadsheet tools to help traders analyze and monitor their trading exposures.
Develop marking tools using market information using Python.
Develop library for the bank pricing and booking systems.
Develop, generate and validate regular analytic reports for the trading desks.
Documentation of theory and implementation (Latex)
Provide test and control framework for front to back operational testing / recoverability
Participate in technology design discussions for scalability and performance
Provide support/tools for explaining P&L, Risk and OTC products pricing.
The team
The Shanghai Quantitative Analytics Group of UBS is an entrepreneurial, cross-asset team focusing on building the market-leading analytics across all asset classes and provides comprehensive quantitative analysis support to all business units throughout the Investment Bank in all regions. In collaboration with trading, the team also takes advantage of the fast growing FinTech trend. It was established in 2006 and located in Lu Jia Zui Financial Town of Shanghai Pudong. It has a stable team of quantitative analysts and developers with a diverse academic background (e.g. Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics and Financial Engineering).
Your Skills And Experience
Graduate between Sep 2027 and Jul 2028. Minimum bachelor's degree from a top tier university, preferably in Science or Finance disciplines (e.g. Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Economics or Financial Engineering).
Strong analytical abilities and sound logic is required.
Familiar with Python, or other object oriented computer languages: C++ , C#, Java. Proficiency in Excel VBA is a plus.
Mastering a statistical program language such as R statistic package is a plus
SQL databases, KDB and Linux is a plus
Good sense with numbers, fast-learning and detail oriented.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your role

Interested in working in finance, specifically in banking, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Summer Internship Program within our Global Banking business.

You’ll Get To

  • evaluate companies and develop models for M&A transactions
  • prepare industry analyses for pitches
  • see first-hand how we provide market-leading solutions
  • execute live innovative deals that transform today's corporate landscape

Your team

You’ll be working in our Global Banking team in Beijing or Shanghai. We’re responsible for providing coverage, advisory, capital markets and financing solutions for corporate, financial institutions and sponsor clients.

Your expertise

We’re Looking For a Candidate Who

  • will graduate between December 2027 and June 2028, and who has less than two years of work experience also has legal working rights in Mainland China
  • has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
  • is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
  • is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
  • can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team. Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Your program

During your 10-week paid internship, you’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm.

You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

About Us

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.
